patches.value: Use Space d = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d), with its L2 norm, real inner product and normalized Lebesgue volume. Fin n indexes the n coordinates (source indices 1,...,n shifted by one); positive integer dimensions are naturals constrained by H001. The parameter u is curried and total in time; only its restriction to positive time is constrained or asserted. Every source map admits such a total extension and every such extension restricts back; positive-time derivatives are local and independent of extension values. H002 is joint ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ on the open positive space-time domain, where scoped ContDiff ∞ is the coercion of the inner ℕ∞ top into WithTop ℕ∞; it requires all finite orders, not the outer top ω (analyticity). dt and dtt are ordinary vector-valued time derivatives; dx evaluates the spatial real Fréchet derivative on the standard coordinate vector; du, duu and dut are the first spatial, repeated spatial and spatial derivative of the time derivative. lap is their finite sum, not a new operator assumption. density uses exactly squared Euclidean norms with no factor 1/2. energy uses Mathlib's total Bochner integral; every asserted use as a finite ordinary energy is accompanied by spatial integrability from T003. sectionGood is only the conjunction of continuity, a finite bound on the box, vanishing off C and integrability, with no built-in mathematical theorem. The positive-order iterated Fréchet derivative vanishing in N002 encodes all mixed partials: in finite dimension its values on coordinate vectors are precisely those partials and multilinearity gives the converse. Real integrals and inner products have scalar ℝ fixed explicitly. No M premise ports or background-note premise ports are introduced. The pinned EuclideanSpace and PiLp definitions use exponent 2 for L2, and EuclideanSpace.single j 1 is the coordinate unit vector. PiLp.volume_preserving_ofLp/toLp identifies this volume with product Lebesgue measure on coordinate functions; T006 separately proves the coordinate-splitting equivalence actually used by Fubini.
